name: Balady Poultry Company
summary: Balady Poultry Company, together with its subsidiaries, produces poultry products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, other GCC countries, and internationally. The company offers whole and marinated chicken; and chicken parts, including gizzards, hearts, breasts, thighs, whole chicken feet, wings, mix chicken pieces, liver, feet, and legs, as well as chicken fillet. It also engages in the rearing and production of laying boiler breeders and operation of its hatcheries; operation of slaughterhouses for the slaughter and preparation of poultry, rabbit, and bird meat; land transportation of refrigerated and frozen goods; sales agents in pharmaceuticals, wholesale of feed and non-pharmaceutical feed…
